integration_notes: Add pub mod blast_hsp_link and numerical helper module hsp_sumstat (seg_translation owns its independent provenance). No shared files edited.

blast_link_hsps(program,listOption,query_info,subject_length_nt,&mut score_blk,link_params,gapped)->i16. Supported standard tblastn uses longest_intron40,gap_size40,overlap_size9,gap_decay_rate0.1 and ordinary amino-acid HSP coordinates. Subject length passed to linker is nucleotide length; wrapper divides only for individual Spouge Evalues and sum helper computes its own subject effective length.

Uses blast_hsp_evaluate::blast_hsp_list_get_evalues and existing blast_hits score sort/odd adjustment; mutable score block must be available after releasing gapped-alignment scratch borrows. No shared HSP fields need extending.

Historical even-gap engine longest_intron<=0 is explicitly unsupported; OOF/PHI/tblastx linking is not exposed. Retained same-source blastx coordinate/window branches have compile/source review only; focused oracle is standard tblastn.
Source wrapper intentionally returns0 after ignoring inner uneven-link status, as original. Empty-list behavior and original num reset are retained.
